offering_description.value: Provides physician-led neonatal intensive care, maternal-fetal medicine, pediatric, and anesthesia services under contracts with hospitals and health systems. Its affiliated physician groups bill payers for the professional care they deliver.

primary_services.value: neonatal intensive care physician services; maternal-fetal medicine; pediatric hospitalist care; anesthesia services; revenue cycle services

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and health systems that contract for staffed physician services; B2G: government health programs such as Medicaid, as payers for patient care

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals; neonatal and maternity care; pediatric care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from insurers and government programs for professional care delivered; service fees: fees from hospitals for contracted physician staffing and management

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs or contracts physicians and sells their care to hospitals, billed to payers

geography_served.value: US national: Operates in many US states through hospital contracts across the country

specialization.value: related lines: neonatal, maternal-fetal, pediatric hospitalist and anesthesia physician services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts negotiated directly with hospitals and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state medical licensing and Medicare and Medicaid billing rules, plus HIPAA privacy rules

notes: The company was formerly known as MEDNAX, so some details may differ from its latest filings.
